verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an API-driven data product, but the evidence documents no batch or bulk endpoint, such as refreshing balances or transactions across many accounts in one call. The only multi-item mention is that a customer linking several accounts produces one webhook event per account. That describes per-item event emission, not a bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
